dialogues.speaker: Toda
dialogues.text: Well... I wouldn't call it "worry" exactly. With the Sakoku Decree's abolition, I'm sure that Inazuma will undergo some changes.

dialogues.speaker: Toda
dialogues.text: I can't be sure what effects this reopening will have on the other nations of Teyvat...

dialogues.speaker: Toda
dialogues.text: ...But though I can't say anything conclusively at the moment, as a member of the Yashiro Commission, all I can do is trust in the Almighty Shogun.

dialogues.speaker: Toda
dialogues.text: If it is the Shogun's decision, then it must be meant to achieve Eternity somehow...
